name: @claudestrator/core
description: Claudestrator's engine (src/) and dashboard page (page/), shared by the VS Code extension, the JetBrains plugin and the desktop app. No editor API: a host drives it.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-page.mjs dist/page
scripts.test:live: npm run build && node dist/test/live/smoke.js && node dist/test/live/blocks.js
